name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSharedReportingEntry.program_meets
theorem_title: Execution of one complete shared reporting entry
natural_language_statement:
Let $h,J,k\in\mathbb N$ with $k\le J$, global width $W=J\cdot464h$, suffix width $V=(J-k)464h$, source cutoff $c\le W$, box cutoff $b\le V$ and switch parameter $t$ be given. Integer subset functions $f,g$ are bounded by $B,D$ through cutoff $c$, with $kh+b\le c$. Suppose memory contains both full source transforms and cells pointing to them, all below a five-cell record destination. Reserve in order that record, local subset/pair rows, two radix prefix areas, box pointers, all local box payloads, mask/index buffers and scratch. Assume the exact ordered nonoverlap bounds, local/global Pascal-power and sorting scratch bounds hold; $t$ and every stated power, radix, address, sorted-key and signed-value bound fit words; addresses fit words; and all pair/global/sort call-depth requirements are allowed. The fixed program constructs the complete entry with metadata $(t,b,\mathrm{boxBase},\mathrm{indexBase},\mathrm{ptrBase})$, sorted physical prefix index and exact box transforms, returns the prefix count, retains both source transforms and meets its stated time. Below the local subset base it changes only the five metadata cells.

This packages all reusable data for exact physical prefix queries into one persistent reporting entry.
explanation: This packages all reusable data for exact physical prefix queries into one persistent reporting entry.

name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSourceBandBanks.Procs.meets
theorem_title: Execution of the complete reusable original-source band banks
natural_language_statement:
Let original value maps $f_L,f_R$, lengths $N_L,N_R$, positive band size $g$, arithmetic modulus $p$, shift $\delta$, parameters $h,J$ and cutoff $c\le W=J\cdot464h$ be given. Suppose memory stores the correct paired original-source bucket catalog and selected cover input. The pair catalog and cover coefficient/candidate/histogram arrays end before occurrence-array base $a$, and the full occurrence array fits before bank base $b$. Assume addresses fit words, the exact bank-constructor space/word bounds fit and depth $d+W+14$ is allowed. With the literal procedure closure present, the program constructs the occurrence array and every independent paired-band source bank, establishes their complete stored-data contract, returns the exact finish address and meets its prescribed time. It preserves every memory cell below $a$.

This makes the entire reusable source-bank collection available from original arrays and actual cover data.
explanation: This makes the entire reusable source-bank collection available from original arrays and actual cover data.

name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingFrontierStep.program_meets
theorem_title: Execution of an exact multi-parent positive-frontier step
natural_language_statement:
Let finite decidable index types carry sets A,B,C with integer maps $a,b,c$. Fix modulus/shift $p,\delta$, parameters $h,J,k$ with $k<J$, wanted label $w$ satisfying its A membership and lifted-key congruence, and a list $U$ of valid depth-$k$ prefixes. Suppose memory stores the exact original source transforms, sorted next-level prefix index, box-pointer row and every corresponding local signed-box transform, together with both current parent-mask rows. All retained data end before the left output, whose reservation of $|U|G(h)$ cells ends before the right output; the latter ends before child scratch. Reserve thereafter complete child masks, left/right child rows, count/selection rows, query-mask buffer and polynomial scratch, in the stated order. Assume exact capacity, power/remainder workspace and word-magnitude bounds, next-level switch/cut conditions, addresses fitting words and depth $d+2W+17$ allowed, where $W=J\cdot464h$.

The fixed step returns the length of

$$U'=\operatorname{flatMap}_{u\in U}\operatorname{positiveChildren}(I,w,u),$$

where $I$ is the original raw-incidence set, and writes precisely the aligned left/right masks of $U'$ in that order. It meets its stated $(h,J,k,t,|U|)$ time and preserves all cells below child scratch outside the two actual output intervals.

This is the full executed frontier transition used by the exact original-incidence reporting tree.
explanation: This is the full executed frontier transition used by the exact original-incidence reporting tree. Its output is the ordered concatenation of the positive children of every stored parent prefix.
